title: Chapter 458 Sacrifice
content:
Chapter 458 Sacrifice

When Jiang Bei heard that the gods in the Land of Gods were still thinking of recruiting themselves, he immediately laughed to the sky and looked at the gods mockingly.

"You guys are so stupid."

Seeing Jiang Bei so arrogant, even though the gods were a little afraid of Jiang Bei's strength, they were still furious at this moment.

"Do you really think my Godly Land can't deal with you?"

The divine light blooms.

Another giant pillar that reaches the sky trembled, and a god came out of it.

This god has a strong body, and it seems that he has terrifying power all over his body.

boom!

An explosion sounded, and the powerful fist surging towards Jiangbei, with amazing momentum and unstoppable momentum!

Feeling the power of this god, Jiang Bei was extremely excited, his blood was gushing out, and he couldn't help but shout, "Good come!"

Suddenly, the breath of the Martial God was completely revealed without any reservation.

Jiangbei was directly in a fierce way, and the momentum of opening and closing was not at all inferior.

As the two of them became anxious, the entire land of the gods began to shake, forcing the other gods to take action to protect them.

But some of the followers in the Land of Gods had no good luck and were directly hit by the aftermath of the battle, with heavy casualties.

Seeing Jiang Bei as brave as he was, the gods looked at each other and saw the strong murderous intent in the other party's eyes.

This person cannot be kept!

Just when the gods are ready to go together and end the battle.

Buzz —

Above the void, a huge black hole reappeared and exposed above the land of the gods.

"Um?"

Seeing this, the gods were puzzled.

According to their speculation, the Chaos Realm cannot be solved so quickly.

Their original intention to deal with the Land of Gods was just to lead the person behind the scenes.

But then, their puzzled faces disappeared suddenly, and replaced by a solemn look.

It is just because there are a group of defeated soldiers and defeated soldiers appearing in the black hole, with no fighting spirit at all, and some are just dangerous.

They lived for endless years, and naturally they were not fools, and they soon knew something.

The subordinates they sent to attack the land of the gods were actually defeated, and they were defeated so quickly.

Did that guy take action?

"God, please forgive us for our incompetence. We have not completed the tasks you have assigned."

Many creatures in the land of gods knelt down to the gods, their faces filled with regret and despair.

But the gods at this time had no time to pay attention to them.

A god was about to speak when his expression suddenly stopped and stared at the huge black hole, with a look of shock in his eyes.

"That's it?!"

Boom!

The entire black hole was suddenly shattered by unknown forces, and then a huge space channel appeared at the location where the black hole originally existed.

Strong auras surged out from the space channel, causing the entire land of gods to tremble slightly.

The gods could no longer sit still and walked out of the giant pillar, looking at the space passage together.

Jiang Bei also stopped the movement in his hand, looked back at the space passage, and felt the familiar aura. Jiang Bei laughed and said, "It seems that today is the day when your gods are destroyed!"

As soon as Jiangbei finished speaking, a murderous roar came from the space passage.

"The land of the gods, prepare to die!"

The huge space channel trembled violently, as if it was under great pressure, and it seemed that it could not hold on.

Seeing this, Jiangbei waved his hand and a stream of energy poured into the space channel, firmly stabilizing it.

The next moment, figures rushed out of the space channel and stood proudly in the void.

This is not finished yet.

In the space channel, countless armies were crushing in a mighty way, bringing a force of swallowing the sky, which was shocking.

At this time, the expressions of the gods were hard to see.

These unknown strong men who suddenly appeared had no idea where they came from.

That guy actually has such powerful energy.

They were careless and underestimated Lu Daosheng.

But now, it's too late to regret.

"Jiangbei, you came so early, but you didn't kill any of you."

Yu Qingfeng saw Jiangbei from afar and chuckled.

His voice was not loud, but it spread throughout the battlefield.

Everyone also immediately discovered Jiangbei.

Jiang Bei was also a little embarrassed. He thought that he would gain a lot when he came here first, but he never thought that the gods also had some skills.

As expected, there are no vain scholars under their reputation.

On the other hand, the gods were so underestimated that their faces were as gloomy as water.

"It's too much!"

When everyone heard this, they laughed.

"Just you beasts deserve to be called humans?"

"Living is also a disaster, hurry up and die!"

The war was about to break out.

The Land of Gods has been managed for endless years, and naturally there is a lot of high-end combat power under his command.

But compared with these strong men in Huangcheng, it is a bit far behind.

Huang Shou, Awei, Yun Qi and others, all of them are first-class strong men, fighting against the gods back and forth.

The remaining powerful people in the Land of Gods were almost massacred.

But even so, the expressions of the people in Huangcheng changed slightly.

There are really many strong people in this land of gods.

It would take several days and nights to kill them. Fortunately, they had the army brought by Yun Qi, otherwise it would have to take some effort.

And at this moment, another movement came from the space channel.

Lu Xue led the powerful men from the Chaos Realm to the Land of Gods. When they saw the Land of Gods that had been in full swing, they were shocked, their blood was boiling, and their fighting spirit was gushing.

"Hahahaha, the land of the gods is today!"

"Kill, kill all these beasts!"

The gods who felt that the situation was hopeless suddenly calmed down.

"This is what you asked for."

"Do you really think my Gods' land is a soft persimmon, so easy to pinch?"

In the center of the land of the gods, six huge pillars of heaven burst into dazzling light.

Immediately afterwards, the light fell like a rainstorm, pouring on every corner of the land of the gods.

Seeing this scene, the faces of the people in Huangcheng changed slightly, and they quickly used methods to block them, but they found that this did not seem to be targeted at them.

"No, you guys see!"

Ouyang Yanqing's eyes were sharp and he immediately pointed at the creatures in the land of the gods.

In the land of the gods, except for the gods and their elite soldiers and generals trained by their subordinates, the rest are some unconscious worshippers. What they have to do all day is to contribute their faith.

And the power of the gods is based on these faith powers.

But with the halo, all the creatures began to die one by one, and their lives turned into essences, all of which were absorbed by giant pillars and fed back to the gods.

In just a moment, the aura of the gods began to rise step by step, shaking the sky began to tremble wildly.

Sacrifice!

The gods sacrificed the creatures in the entire land of the gods, and exchanged themselves for stronger power.

This power has vaguely surpassed the powerful people in the Huangcheng City and is still increasing.
